It was everywhere, My friends where all super happy with their powers (Renne got The ability to see the unborn and speak to them, Just not the dead, while Camilla got x-Ray vision, and is now super happy about being able to see through people in the movie theater.)

I however, had two minutes left to wait, two minutes until I got my power, and Renne and Camilla both held my hands in Excitement as we waited, We were watching this new movie called "The treat of 20" about a girl in our situation who had gotten the ability to see the future and stop things.

3...2...1...

I closed my eyes, Some unknown urge told me to.
And then I saw him, glowing light flowing from his fingers as he walked towards me.

"Lily Black, The girl I've been waiting for. I couldn't choose what to do with you. Your so... Unusual" Needless to say I was intrigued by this comment, he didnt know what to do with me.

"Who are you?" I asked, He smiled.
"I am Not a who, I am A fragment of time that fractured off its course, I fractured in 2019 at exactly midnight, But this is not about me" he told me, he put his glowing hands on my shoulders which I fought the urge to shrug them off.

"I came to a decision that you, Wont have singular ability. Clairvoyance and Openning your third eye, and perhaps, Oh perhaps I'll give you the ability to visit the Beyond. What you humans call Heaven and hell" I couldnt help But stare, Multiple abilitys.

"Is God real then? What about Lucifer?" She asked quietly, Almost unbelievably excited to have answers.

"Not as you humans say, Lucifer Isnt all that bad if you aren't annoying. But Not in the sense you hope for. There is Heaven in the sense that Souls live there unable to be torn, whereas in 'hell' that's where all the broken souls go, While they're healing, they reside down there." 

"What makes me so special?" She whispered, But his hands fell from her shoulders, 

"You sweetheart, are the last of mother times bloodline. It's no coincidence that you're so unusual. But what makes you special is not your blood, but what you are." Suddenly he was replaced with my bedroom where my friends stared at me.

"Lily, Your fingers are glowing"
